mechanism: The structural damage is old: the twin channel deaths of 08-07 with their zeroed-URF reading were the last event, and in the eight sessions since the field has re-knit — no further deaths, stability S_UF climbing to 0.899/0.900 (the firmest of the whole recent window) while URF drains from 0.56 to 0.36 and normal force F_n stiffens toward 2.5. Price still leaks to a marginal new low at 11.79, but the descent is decelerating against an intact, tightening lattice: the year-long relaxation from the 48 peak is being absorbed, tension stored rather than released. Continued downward displacement would require fresh channel deaths, and none are arriving.
